in_marathi.name: Shaambhini
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of love and beauty
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shaambhini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shaambhini is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shambhu' which means 'Beneficent', 'Gracious' or 'Goddess of Love'. It is also believed to be the name of the goddess of love, beauty and grace. The name signifies the divine feminine energy that is present in every woman and embodies love, nurturing, and grace.
